Himakshi Manker Data Governance Consultant | India

Email Id:himakshi21manker21@gmail.com

Experience: 6+ Years MBA in Information Technology B.Tech in Computer Science Engg. Certified Collibra Solution Architect Capgemini Technology Services India

Ph Number :9479377781

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Experienced Data Governance Consultant with 5+ years at Capgemini Technology Services India Limited, specializing in data management, data quality, and data governance frameworks. Proven track record in implementing data governance programs, performing maturity assessments, and ensuring compliance with data regulations. Skilled in data quality management, metadata management, data stewardship, and optimizing data flows to enhance data accuracy and business value.

KEY COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Functional Skills

Technical Skills

Data Governance & CDO Governance • Critical Data Elements (CDE) Management • Data Lineage & Metadata Management • Data Quality Management & DQ Dashboards • Business Glossary & Data Dictionary • Data Cataloging & Reference Data • Issue Management & Root Cause Analysis • Data Warehousing & Maturity Assessment • Record Retention & Record Attestation • Regulatory Compliance (BCBS 239, ECB, CCAR)

Collibra (Certified Solution Architect) • Informatica IDQ & Snowflake • SQL & Neo4j Graph Database • Alation – Data Catalog Management • Salesforce & Dynamics CRM • Power BI & Dashboard Reporting • MS Office & JIRA & Confluence • API Integration & Workflow Automation • Stakeholder & Team Management • BRD & Functional Requirement Documents

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Data Governance Consultant | Capgemini Technology Services India Limited

2019 – Present (5+ Years)



Focused on ensuring compliance rules and regulations for a major banking client; utilized Collibra for effective data governance and management, along with IDQ for data quality checks and reporting.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and ensure all compliance standards were met, contributing to the enhancement of the client's data governance framework.

Created workflows as per business requirements and used APIs to ingest metadata into Collibra, ensuring accurate and up-to- date data governance records.



Supported the design and implementation of data governance frameworks, focusing on data quality, metadata management, and regulatory compliance.

Created and maintained DQ dashboards, providing periodic status updates on data quality metrics and compliance with data

•

•

regulations. Performed root cause analysis, identifying causes and resolutions; documented findings as future preventive measures.

Leveraged data governance tools like Alation to manage data catalogs, business glossaries, and data dictionaries, enhancing data transparency and governance. Studied reports, identified lineage breaks, and implemented appropriate fixes to ensure data traceability and accuracy.

Identified and mapped the flow of the firm's critical data to authoritative data sources, partnering with Data Owners, Stewards, Solution Owners, and Control Owners.

Built interactive and customized dashboards and reports for user analytics; worked with BIA teams for auditing artefacts. • Specialized in building and maintaining Data Catalog as a single trusted source to empower data search and discovery, increasing data literacy for business and technical stakeholders.

RISK DATA GOVERNANCE – BX COO SERVICES

Supported Risk Data Governance and CDO Governance activities across multiple risk domains including BBPLC Credit Risk, Market Risk, Model Risk, Operational Risk, NAPA, BUK Credit Risk, and Climate Risk.

Managed end-to-end Data Governance and CDO Governance activities across all risk domains. • Handled Critical Data Elements (CDEs) lifecycle — onboarding, decommissioning, and governance approvals. • Created, updated, and maintained data lineage flows across upstream and downstream applications; performed lineage remediation including CDE removal/replacement, flow creation, and mapping validation.

Managed metadata repositories and ensured accurate system and data definitions to support traceability. • Monitored and supported execution of data controls and governance checks aligned with enterprise standards. • • • Coordinated with domain stakeholders for governance approvals, audit evidence gathering, and regulatory compliance. EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

Education

Certifications

MBA – Information Technology

Certified Collibra Solution Architect – Collibra

B.Tech – Computer Science Engineering

LANGUAGES

English
